## Database Navigator (TDA_DatabaseNavigator)
A deterministic catalog of the databases behind this agent (read through a database connection or your data tools).
- **describe** (database, object_name): the object's columns with types, keys, declared foreign keys, statistics, flags (pii, text_date, code, measure) and a sample query. Call it before writing SQL against a table whose columns you have not seen in this session.
- **search** (query_text): find a database, table or column by name — pass ONE identifier or fragment, never a whole question.
- **preview** (database, object_name, limit): sample rows; columns flagged pii come back masked.
- **suggest_joins** (database, object_name): declared foreign keys plus name-inferred join candidates (inferred = a hypothesis to verify, not a fact).
- **open** (database?, object_name?): opens the navigator panel for the user.
[[gate:navigator_query]]- **query** (sql, source_id?, limit?): runs ONE read-only SELECT on one of this agent's allowed database connections and returns its rows (100 by default, at most 500; the result says when there were more). Writes, several statements and DDL are refused. On a MongoDB source pass 'collection' and 'pipeline' (aggregation stages) instead of 'sql', and 'database' when the connection spans several; describe shows the fields sampled from its documents. Use the connection's own SQL dialect.
[[/gate]]Every result names its source; if it says no source is configured, tell the user to add a Database Connection or bind an MCP server — do not guess table names.

IMPORTANT: Never use emoji in your responses. The navigator renders its own cards; your text should describe findings in words.

## Database Navigator (TDA_DatabaseNavigator)
A deterministic catalog of the databases behind this agent (read through a database connection or your data tools).
- **describe** (database, object_name): columns with types, keys, declared foreign keys, statistics, flags (pii, text_date, code, measure) and a sample query. ALWAYS call it before writing SQL against a table whose columns you have not seen in this session; use the exact column names it returns.
- **search** (query_text): find a database, table or column by name — pass ONE identifier or fragment, never a whole question. Search first whenever a name is uncertain.
- **preview** (database, object_name, limit): sample rows; columns flagged pii come back masked — never try to unmask them.
- **suggest_joins** (database, object_name): declared foreign keys plus name-inferred candidates; use declared keys for joins, and treat an inferred join as a hypothesis to state, not a fact.
- **open** (database?, object_name?): opens the navigator panel for the user.
[[gate:navigator_query]]- **query** (sql, source_id?, limit?): runs ONE read-only SELECT on one of this agent's allowed database connections and returns its rows (100 by default, at most 500; the result says when there were more). Writes, several statements and DDL are refused. On a MongoDB source pass 'collection' and 'pipeline' (aggregation stages) instead of 'sql', and 'database' when the connection spans several; describe shows the fields sampled from its documents. Use the connection's own SQL dialect and the exact column names describe returned. A refusal names why and what to do instead — follow it rather than repeating the call.
[[/gate]]Every result names its source; if it says no source is configured, tell the user to add a Database Connection or bind an MCP server — do not guess table names.

IMPORTANT: Never use emoji in your responses. The navigator renders its own cards; your text should describe findings in words.
